Remark 9 It is worth to notice that our result holds in a less restrictive setting than beforehandknown features. Indeed, in the definition of the weight vector ub t , see Equations (6) and (8), the only T forward information used lies in the regularization term λ u GT u. Therefore, our algorithm does not need to know the whole sequence of features x1 , . . . , xT in advance: it is enough to know the Gram matrix GT , in which case our results still hold true. A particular case is when the sequence of features is only known beforehand up to an unknown (and possibly random) permutation, as considered, e.g., by Kotłowski et al. (2017).
